data.claim: Removing explanatory rationale from seven core argument descriptions and the shared relation text brings core from 40,538 to under 40,000. Lean and families need nothing: B66b0d8218e-2 already put them under their limits.
data.falsifier: The projected size after the replacements stays above 40,000, or a test pins one of the removed sentences.
data.mechanism: tools/list serves Param.help. The chosen params set cli_help separately, so the MCP text can shrink without moving any CLI help. Text is counted once per listing tool, and relation repeats in 4 core tools.

data.question: Can the core tier of tools/list return under the 40,000 ratchet by cutting rationale text only, with no tool or argument dropped and no CLI help changed?

evidence.note: R56357403c8 CONFIRMED: project.py projected 40,538 -> 39,925 from rationale cuts alone; measured after the change: core 39,869.

r-surface-budget: tools/list keeps its ceiling, paid for by trimming descriptions, and no ceiling was raised. r-docs-with-the-change: only MCP description text moved; the changed params set their own cli_help or an empty one, so no CLI help or docs change. Recalled D-mcp-budget-report (only core is ratcheted) and L4749e7a4a0.

Commit 075314bec. Regression tests are the 3 failing on main: test_mcp_tool_budget::test_tools_list_bytes_per_tier_are_reported, test_mcp_tool_tiers::test_sizes_core_under_budget_standard_between, test_kind_data_surface::test_the_tools_list_carries_the_record_tool_and_core_keeps_its_ratchet; each failed before (core 40,538) and passes after (core 39,869). test_mcp_identity caught a lost word, restored. No budget raised, no tool or argument dropped.

chunk_findings.detail: The change removes “Omit at first.” from the `relation` tool argument description. This was not rationale: it was the instruction that prevents a first submission from carrying a `relation` value. With the new description, an MCP client or LLM answering an initial “possible duplicate” refusal can emit `relation="new"` (or another listed value) on the first call because all listed values are presented as immediate answers; the caller may then prematurely record a duplicate relation or be rejected, whereas the previous schema explicitly guarded against that. This violates the stated intent to trim only rationale text and changes observable API guidance.
